svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: SPI timing of one frame
svg.desc: SPI timing of the ADS7952 in mode 0: CS low frames a 16-clock word, SDI is read on each rising SCLK edge, SDO changes on each falling edge and is released after the 16th, with the setup, hold, delay and quiet times of the datasheet.
svg.text: SPI mode 0 (CPOL 0, CPHA 0). Datasheet: 7.9 Timing Requirements, p. 17;
Setup time from CS low to the first rising SCLK edge. At +VBD = 1.8 V; 6 ns
Delay from CS low to the first data bit (DO15) on SDO. At +VBD = 1.8 V; 27
ns at 3 V, 17 ns at 5 V
Delay from a falling SCLK edge to the next SDO bit valid. At +VBD = 1.8 V;
27 ns at 3 V, 17 ns at 5 V
Hold time of the SDO bit after a falling SCLK edge. At +VBD = 5 V; 5 ns at 3
Setup time of SDI before a rising SCLK edge. At +VBD = 5 V; 3 ns at 3 V, 2
Hold time of SDI after a rising SCLK edge. At +VBD = 1.8 V; 10 ns at 3 V, 6 ns
Delay from the 16th falling SCLK edge to SDO released. At +VBD = 1.8 V; 22
ns at 3 V, 13 ns at 5 V
Quiet time from SDO released to the start of the next conversion
CS high time between two frames
Each +VBD column of 7.9 covers a band: 1.8 V is 1.7 V to 1.9 V, 3 V is 2.7
V to 3.6 V, 5 V is 4.75 V to 5.25 V; outputs with a 50 pF load.
